title_en: At Farka Front Lake Spectacular Villa With Lake View For Sale!!!
description_en: In Farka Front Lake Residence, Super Villa With Lake View For Sale!! The villa has a building surface of 304m2, ground floor 197m2 and first floor 106m2. The villa has a plot area of ​​387 m2, including 2 parking spaces. In this Residence, payment can also be made with this. The residence stands out for high-quality and modern works, construction among private villas, three-story buildings and infrastructure alternating with the elements of nature. It should be noted that the residence is located on the edge of the lake and has a direct exit to the pedestrian area. Currently, the complex is in the construction phase and is expected to be completed in 2 and a half years. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
